'''Oryyka howlers''' were territorial arboreal predators from [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] that were noted for being vengeful animals that often followed [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] hunters that had violated their territory. Their loud cries only served to scatter a Wookiee's prey whereupon the howler would flee back to its tree.
